claims.claim_text: Indexed Major Forrest J. Sanborn is confirmed as chemical engineer Forrest John Sanborn, who entered the Army in 1942 and spent four years in OSS bombing research.
claims.evidence_excerpt: During World War II he spent four years in the Office of Strategic Services doing research on bombing.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary obituary supplies the full middle name, chemical-engineering occupation, Army commissioning chronology and direct OSS service; an official Congressional Record independently identifies his wartime plant-protection work.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact full name and middle initial, commissioned Army trajectory, technical specialty and an explicit OSS service statement.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources confirm wartime identity and OSS work but do not date his OSS entry precisely or name the immediate predecessor employer.
claims.match_notes: The obituary and Congressional Record align with the indexed major; Box 674 remains necessary for the accession date and pre-OSS sequence.

claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed identity from the same obituary's exact name, Army chronology and explicit OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: The occupation is documented across his prewar and wartime career, but the source does not name his immediate pre-OSS employer.
